title: Cernoziom, no irrigation, Dobrogea, mid-September
rationale: Cernoziom is suitable for every candidate, so there is no soil exclusion. The ordering rests on water: rapita_toamna has drought_tolerance scazuta and its first critical period is 'răsărire – formarea rozetei (septembrie-octombrie)', i.e. exactly the weeks this case covers, while grau_toamna is medie. Cobadin has no irrigation, 2 drought-flagged years in 10, a last-month precipitation anomaly of -8.4 mm and a 552 mm annual normal, the driest of the six captured sites after Reviga. That is enough to rank wheat above rapeseed but not enough to exclude rapeseed: 552 mm still clears rapița's season_need_mm.min of 450.
